title: Seven Ships

mood.label: Heavy going
mood.summary: Heavy going: Trump hints at new Iran strikes, Iran claims seven ships hit in Hormuz, Brent nears $113, Kyiv frets as Trump leans toward Putin, and a Tibet quake kills 16. Small lifts: Venezuelans march peacefully, Indonesia spares a forest, Samoan wildlife returns.

style.genre: slow soul ballad — Rhodes, muted trumpet, upright bass, RhythmAce

lines: He says they knocked the hell out of them,
and maybe there's more to send;
Tehran counts seven ships on fire,
The oil climbs up to one-thirteen,
But Caracas walks without a stone,
and on one small Samoan isle
the birds have come back round.
